name: web-contactcars-arabic-car-marketplace-page-collage
title: ContactCars Arabic car marketplace: tilted collage of long pages with a red Mercedes
whatItIs: A light-blue cover with several long Arabic website pages tilted and overlapping: a hero with a red Mercedes coupé and a search form, brand logo rows, listing cards of cars with prices, and a mobile app screenshot, with the ContactCars logo in the corner.
whatItMeans: Busy but trustworthy; the page collage shows breadth of a large marketplace at a glance.
techniques: Tilt and overlap full-length pages into a collage.
Repeat a hero car cut-out across pages.
Include brand logo rows as a navigation device.

vocabulary.definition: A card showing one item for sale.
